fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 冬，十一月，甲子，立皇后羊氏，赦天下。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: In winter, the eleventh month, on jiazi, Lady Yang was made empress and the realm amnestied.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: In winter, the eleventh month, on the day jiazi, Lady Yang was established as empress and the realm was granted amnesty.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 後，尚書郎泰山羊玄之之女也。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: She was the daughter of Yang Xuanzhi, Gentleman of the Masters of Writing of Taishan.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: The empress was the daughter of Yang Xuanzhi, Gentleman of the Masters of Writing of Taishan.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 外祖平南將軍樂安孫旂，與孫秀善，故秀立之。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Her maternal grandfather was Sun Qi, General Who Pacifies the South of Le'an, friendly with Xiu, which is why Xiu made her empress.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Her maternal grandfather was Sun Qi, General Who Pacifies the South of Le'an, on good terms with Sun Xiu, and therefore Xiu established her.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 拜玄之光祿大夫、特進、散騎常侍，封興晉侯。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Xuanzhi was made Household Grandee, Special Courtier, Gentleman of the Encampment, and Marquis of Xingjin.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Xuanzhi was appointed Household Grandee, Special Courtier, and Gentleman of the Encampment, enfeoffed as Marquis of Xingjin.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 廞又遣兵逆西夷校尉陳總。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Xin also sent troops against Colonel of the Western Yi Chen Zong.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Xin also sent troops to oppose the Colonel of the Western Yi Chen Zong.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 總至江陽，聞廞有異志，主簿蜀郡趙模曰：「今州郡不協，必生大變，當速行赴之。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: At Jiangyang Zong heard of Xin's rebellion. Chief Clerk Zhao Mo said: "Province and prefecture are in conflict. You must hurry.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: When Zong reached Jiangyang and heard Xin had rebellious intent, his Chief Clerk Zhao Mo of Shu commandery said: "Conflict between province and prefecture grows deep; you must hurry on.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 府是兵要，助順討逆，誰敢動者！」
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: The headquarters is the military hinge. Aid the lawful and punish the rebel—who would dare resist!"
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: The headquarters is the military key—aid the lawful and punish the rebel; who would dare move!"

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 總更緣道停留，比至南安魚涪津，已遇廞軍，模白總：「散財募士以拒戰，若克州軍，則州可得；
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Zong delayed on the road. At Nan'an's Yu ford he met Xin's army. Mo urged: "Spend wealth and recruit men. Defeat the provincial army and you may take the province;
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Zong instead lingered along the route; by the time he reached the Yu ford of Nan'an he already met Xin's army. Mo told Zong: "Disperse wealth and recruit men to fight; if you defeat the provincial army you may take the province;

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 不克，順流而退，必無害也。」
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: if not, withdraw downstream and you will be safe."
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: if not, withdraw downstream and you will surely come to no harm."

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 總曰：「趙益州忿耿侯，故殺之；
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Zong said: "Inspector Zhao killed Marquis Geng out of anger;
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Zong said: "Inspector Zhao resents Marquis Geng and therefore killed him;

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 與吾無嫌，何為如此！」
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: he has no quarrel with me. Why would he do this to me?"
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: he has no quarrel with me—why act thus!"

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 模曰：「今非起事，必當殺君以立威。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Mo said: "This is rebellion. He will kill you to make an example.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Mo said: "This is no mere uprising—he will surely kill you to establish his authority.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 雖不戰，無益也！」
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Even without fighting it will not help!"
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Even if you do not fight, it will not help!"

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 言至垂涕，總不聽，眾遂自潰。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: He spoke until he wept. Zong would not listen and the troops scattered.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: He spoke until tears fell; Zong would not listen and the host thereupon scattered of itself.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 總逃草中，模著總服格戰；
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Zong hid in the grass. Mo donned Zong's robe and fought;
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Zong hid in the grass; Mo put on Zong's robe and fought;

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 廞兵殺模，見其非是，更搜求得總，殺之。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Xin's men killed Mo. Finding he was not Zong, they searched again, found Zong, and killed him.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Xin's soldiers killed Mo; seeing he was not the man, they searched again, found Zong, and killed him.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 廞自稱大都督，大將軍、益州牧，署置僚屬，改易守令。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Xin styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand General, and Governor of Yi, appointed staff, and replaced local officials.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Xin styled himself Grand Commander-in-Chief, Grand General, and Governor of Yi Province, appointed staff, and changed the garrison commanders and magistrates.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 王官被召，無敢不往。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: When court officials were summoned, none dared refuse.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: When court officials were summoned none dared not go.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 李庠帥妹婿李含、天水任回、上官昌、扶風李攀、始平費他、氐苻成、隗伯等四千騎歸廞。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Li Xiu led Li Han, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan, Fei Ta, Fu Cheng, Wei Bo, and four thousand horsemen to join Xin.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Li Xiu led his brothers-in-law Li Han of Tianshui, Ren Hui, Shangguan Chang, Li Pan of Fufeng, Fei Ta of Shiping, the Di Fu Cheng, and Wei Bo and others with four thousand horsemen to join Xin.

fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.zh: 廞以庠為威寇將軍，封陽泉亭侯，委以心膂，使招合六郡壯勇至萬餘人，以斷北道。
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.en: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan, trusted him deeply, and had him gather more than ten thousand braves of six commanderies to block the northern road.
fullGoverningChineseAndPairedEnglish.literal: Xin made Xiu General Who Subdues Bandits and Marquis of Yangquan Pavilion, entrusted him as close confidant, and had him gather braves of the six commanderies to more than ten thousand to cut the northern road.

value.event: Sun Xiu installed Lady Yang as empress because of his friendship with Sun Qi
Li Xiang led four thousand horsemen to join Zhao Xin and became General Who Subdues Bandits
